# Live resume regression

`claude-2.1.319-partial-validation.json` records the bounded compatibility investigation: twelve aggregate forwarded Haiku attempts, including the historical one-pixel failure, a successful 64×64 RGB image, and the passing prescribed five-request smoke. `claude-2.1.319-protocol.ndjson` is a derived protocol-only stdout export for the image and five smoke generations (99 rows). It preserves per-child event order and safe stream/assistant/result fields; initialization/control/account payloads and headers are omitted, IDs are consistently replaced, and opaque signatures are redacted. `t_ms:0` means timing unavailable, not simultaneous events. It is not complete bidirectional replay or byte-exact signed-thinking evidence. This historical partial report is superseded by `claude-2.1.319-validation.json` and `claude-2.1.319-phase0.ndjson`: a separately authorized phase used three of twelve allowed Haiku forwards for enabled/adaptive thinking and signed resume, then two zero-provider-request stale refusals. The 432-row bidirectional export preserves initialization/control shapes with private initialization values, IDs, paths and opaque signatures redacted. Exact signed-block comparisons were performed on private captures; redacted fixtures alone cannot prove them. Timestamped lifecycle observations and limitations are recorded in the report. See `docs/protocol.md` for the accepted clod-only replacement of the SDK capture driver, injected-text review and cleanup paths. The tested-version marker is now 2.1.319; original 2.1.308 fixtures, including the one-pixel negative image, retain their historical provenance.

`usage-limit.ndjson` reproduces the assistant error shape reported from line 17 of the dedicated clod workdir transcript `39ab2033-8f9c-4280-90f4-f206497dc8e0.jsonl`. Identifiers are replaced and unrelated envelope fields omitted; the typed error metadata, synthetic model, stop reason, zero usage and limit text are retained. It is offline regression evidence, not a new live capture or validation.

`image64-requests.json` is an offline export of the first two real incoming bodies in `scripts/cache-measurements/image64-diagnosis/incoming.ndjson`, generated by `scripts/sanitize-image64.py`. Roles, content-block ordering and image bytes are preserved; system/tools/model and text are replaced with deterministic non-private values. The test supplies a fixed conversation identity (headers were not recorded) and constructs a synthetic checkpoint from request 2's historical prefix. This verifies the real multi-user message shape plans Resume, not a newly captured CLI resume.

`native-search.ndjson` and `empty-input.ndjson` are existing sanitized CLI stdout captures. Both verify Commit and echoed follow-up Resume offline; native-search declares tool_search explicitly and satisfies the same final-assistant/ID/message gates as prefixed calls.

`bare-lookup.ndjson` is an allowlisted sanitized export of run `scripts/captures/live-verify-20261026-182054/stdout-da75a49beb084a669eaee4530a799a99.ndjson` records 7–17 and terminal result19. Stream deltas/order, assistant/tool/session IDs and the CLI error result are preserved; initialization, account/rate-limit metadata, timestamps, request IDs, usage/cost, and nonessential envelope fields are omitted. Test replay verifies pending ID `toolu_01Qva23KkpYqaUuuEhBRHNgd`, input alpha, Commit and echoed real-result Resume. The live transcript's record15 tool → record16 error and clean fork probe run182301 justify bare-only eligibility; this fixture replay itself is offline, not another live fork. Mixed bare/prefixed turns remain discarded because that ancestry was not provable live.

`requests.json` contains the first two real Polytoken request bodies from the Haiku diagnostic run `resume-diagnostic-1`. `tool-stdout.ndjson` contains that first CLI run's real stdout, in order, excluding its account-bearing control initialization response and nonessential system initialization. The original historical cth9j7z8 baseline did not capture stdout; these are newly captured diagnostic records, not fabricated replacements for missing evidence.

Paths, emails, tokens and account fields are sanitized by `scripts/make-resume-fixture.py`. Internal-source path examples in captured system text are replaced with placeholders; these fixtures are not byte-exact copies of the original request bodies. Identity headers were not retained by the historical body recorder, so the test supplies one fixed conversation identity for both bodies. The diagnostic shell key/effect logs independently verified equal lookup/commit keys.

The live streamed tool_use carries `caller: {"type":"direct"}`. Polytoken omits this provider metadata in its typed assistant echo. Before the fix, Exchange committed a prefix containing caller and the next request failed PrefixMismatch. Content-only caller normalization makes the captured exchange resume without ignoring fields inside tool inputs/schemas.
